contract: lab/memory_shaping.py substitution-delta (each fact = 3 taught deltas + 3 styled approvals)
notes: Vesper persona memory pack: permanent 'about the user' facts taught as
shaped episodic plugs (pet_kepler machinery at slightly larger scale).
teach = the episode (trained); queries = the question-match gate side
Query tokens are chosen pairwise-disjoint per row so similar-but-wrong
questions separate at qtau=0.5: 'favorite anime?' fires only mem_gundam,
'favorite color?' fires nothing.  Banned from ALL query sets: favorite,
like, love, hate, think, feel, opinion, name, tell, whats (except
mem_gundam), whos - each one makes a 2-token question score exactly 0.5
against the wrong row (the documented qtau edge).

legacy_notes: Gate-side re-voice of mem_edit (training episodes unchanged): the
shipped queries carried 'favorite' and 'like', so 'favorite anime?'
and 'Do you like cars?' matched mem_edit at exactly 0.5 and would
co-fire its 'helix' bonus with the persona rows.  The re-voiced set
keeps mem_edit green on its own probes (0.67 on 'What is my favorite
text editor?') while scoring 0 on the persona/canary battery.
